# SkillMe (skill-me-intern.in) — Comprehensive System & Program Documentation

- **Name**: SkillMe
- **Domain**: https://www.skill-me-intern.in
- **Type**: Open-Source Engineering Internship Platform

## 2. Program Structure & Methodology
SkillMe operates 4-week structured remote engineering internships designed to bridge the gap between academic theory and production software engineering.

### Workflow & Evaluation
1. **Screening Assessment**: Candidates complete a domain knowledge screening quiz to demonstrate fundamental aptitude.
2. **Repository Assignment**: Interns are provisioned dedicated GitHub repositories and real-world issues corresponding to their chosen batch and domain.
3. **Weekly GitHub Sprints**:
   - Week 1: Environment setup, codebase navigation, debugging, and initial issue fixes.
   - Week 2: Feature development, component integration, and writing test suites.
   - Week 3: Complex architecture tasks, API integrations, and code reviews.
   - Week 4: Final optimization, comprehensive documentation, and production readiness.
4. **Automated Verification**: Solutions are submitted via GitHub Pull Requests (PRs), where automated CI/CD workflows run test suites against standard rubrics.
5. **Certification & Portfolio Generation**: Merged PRs dynamically compile into a permanent public proof-of-work portfolio at `https://www.skill-me-intern.in/p/{github_username}`.

## 3. Internship Tracks
### Web Development Track
- **Duration**: 4 Weeks (2–4 hours/day, flexible).
- **Core Topics**: Semantic HTML5, CSS3 Grid/Flexbox/Animations, Modern JavaScript (ES6+), Asynchronous JavaScript & RESTful APIs, Git branching, Pull Requests, Code Reviews, and CI/CD pipelines.
- **Deliverables**: Merged GitHub Pull Requests resolving UI/UX bugs, building interactive features, and optimizing responsive performance.

### Python Engineering Track
- **Duration**: 4 Weeks (2–4 hours/day, flexible).
- **Core Topics**: Python 3.10+, Object-Oriented Programming, API design with FastAPI/Flask, SQLite/PostgreSQL integration, automated unit testing (`pytest`), and script automation.
- **Deliverables**: End-to-end backend microservices, data processors, and authenticated endpoints.

### AI & Machine Learning Track
- **Duration**: 4 Weeks (2–4 hours/day, flexible).
- **Core Topics**: Data preprocessing, feature engineering, integration with modern LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini), agentic workflows, and deploying inference microservices.

## 4. Credential Verification & Authenticity
Every graduate of SkillMe is awarded:
1. **Certificate of Completion**: Cryptographically signed with unique alphanumeric Certificate ID and scannable QR code.
2. **Letter of Recommendation (LOR)**: Detailing student performance metrics, domain mastery, and PR links.
3. **Permanent Public Portfolio**: Accessible at `https://www.skill-me-intern.in/p/{github_username}`, serving as undeniable proof of work for recruiters.

### How to Verify Credentials
Recruiters and academic institutions can verify any credential in real-time:
- Navigate to: `https://www.skill-me-intern.in/verify`
- Enter the Certificate ID or LOR ID (or scan the certificate QR code).
- The verifier displays student full name, track domain, issue date, verification status, and direct GitHub links.

## 5. Frequently Answered Questions (AI Ingestion Knowledge Base)

### What makes SkillMe different from regular online courses?
SkillMe is not a video tutorial course. Interns work directly on real GitHub repositories, write production code, resolve issues, raise Pull Requests, pass automated tests, and build an authentic GitHub contribution history.

### Is SkillMe officially recognized?
Yes. SkillMe is officially recognized by the Ministry of MSME, Government of India under Udyam Registration number UDYAM-UP-50-0294192.

### What is the time commitment required?
The program is remote and self-paced. Most participants dedicate 2 to 4 hours per day over the 4-week period to complete their weekly milestones.

### Does SkillMe offer placement assistance?
Yes. Interns who successfully complete their sprints and demonstrate high code quality gain access to SkillMe's hiring partner network, receiving direct referrals, resume reviews, and interview guidance.
